title: S01 Three Hoop Cycle Rack - Local Foot Repair
description: Version 2 same-ID repair of the three-hoop cycle parking rack: six low local mounting feet replace the former full-width ballast rails that blocked the tested city bicycle tires and stand. Retains three continuous open hoops; occupied width approximately 1.35 m and nominal repeat pitch 1.8 m. Independent editable fixed mesh components. The tested bicycle remains supported by its own tires and deployed stand; this rack does not promise wheel clamping, leaning support, anti-theft performance, dynamic insertion or load certification.
